create_HelloStretchKinematics_robot: create a HelloStretchKinematics robot instance with pinocchio IK solver and default URDF paths
manip_ik_inverse_kinematics: compute inverse kinematics for the Stretch robot end-effector given a 4x4 pose query matrix
interpolate_robot_configuration: interpolate between two robot configurations yielding step-by-step state and action pairs for navigation and arm motion
set_config_joint_positions: set the Stretch robot joint configuration from a full-body q vector including base, lift, arm, wrist, and head
create_action_from_config: create a ContinuousFullBodyAction from a robot configuration q vector for use with the Habitat action interface
